resources.name: FlyWire: Method of the Year 2025 (Nature Methods)
LIF model from Shiu et al. (Nature 2024)

limitations: No exact Figshare record, DOI or primary page matching data_CL_SCS and the imported postural-ECAP description was found.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Rejected dataset candidate without a stable identifier or primary record.
decisions.note: Do not treat the imported ECAP/posture description as an available dataset.

searches.query: site:figshare.com ECAP conductivity directional contacts SCS

limitations: No exact Figshare record or DOI matching the claimed combination of ECAP amplitudes, directional contacts and tissue conductivity was found.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Rejected dataset candidate without a stable identifier or verified composition.
decisions.note: A general Figshare domain cannot substantiate availability or contents.

searches.query: Newcastle epidural spinal recordings ECAP doublet ESAP EMG

verified_claims: The publication characterizes ECAPs, doublets, ESAPs and EMG in preclinical epidural spinal recordings.
limitations: The checked source is a preclinical publication, not a confirmed openly downloadable human dataset.
Species and recording geometry limit direct use for human SCS outcome prediction.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Preclinical publication on electrophysiological components and artifacts in epidural spinal recordings.
decisions.note: Retained as measurement-model evidence, not as an available validation dataset.

verified_claims: Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.3732197 provides RADO-SCS 3.0 CAD/STL anatomy for T9-T11 and clinical leads.
The record documents a 0.1-mm anatomical representation and a FEM-to-axon modeling workflow.
limitations: RADO-SCS is a CAD-derived model resource, not executable SCS modeling software.
It does not include pathological or patient-specific spinal anatomy.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Open CAD/STL anatomical resource for constructing conventional, high-frequency, DRG and trans-spinal stimulation models.
decisions.note: Exact Zenodo record and model/software distinction were confirmed.

verified_claims: Repository contains NEURON simulation and EMG-analysis code underlying Balaguer et al. (2025).
It models interaction of epidural SCS, supraspinal input and motoneuron pools after spinal injury.
limitations: The model addresses motor control after spinal-cord injury, not chronic-pain relief or ECAP prediction.
Local reproducibility and parameter provenance were not independently tested.
decisions.corrected_purpose: NEURON-based biophysical SCS model and analysis code for motor-circuit mechanisms after spinal-cord injury.
decisions.note: Relevant as mechanistic software, not as a pain-outcome model.

verified_claims: Repository provides NEURON/NetPyNE code intended to reproduce the SCS network model from Sagalajev et al.
The README links DOI 10.1016/j.neuron.2023.10.021.
limitations: The repository is small and has no release package or automated reproducibility evidence.
Its pain-suppression mechanism is a model hypothesis, not a clinical-outcome predictor.
decisions.corrected_purpose: NEURON/NetPyNE implementation of a published spinal-cord-stimulation network model.
decisions.note: Execution and numerical reproduction remain a later feasibility gate.

verified_claims: NRV is an actively developed Python library for peripheral nervous-system stimulation modeling.
The repository includes documentation, examples, tests and tutorials.
limitations: NRV targets peripheral nerves and is not a ready-made spinal-cord or ECAP model.
Its redirected organization URL should replace the former personal-repository URL.
decisions.corrected_purpose: General multiscale Python framework for in-silico peripheral-nerve stimulation.
decisions.note: Potential component only; spinal-cord applicability requires a separate model.

verified_claims: Repository publishes an open design for a programmable transcutaneous current stimulator.
limitations: This is stimulation hardware, not a validated SCS simulator, dataset or clinical device.
Safety, regulatory status and suitability for any human experiment are not established by the repository.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Open programmable transcutaneous current-stimulator hardware design for engineering reference only.
decisions.note: Not authorized here for human use or self-experimentation.

searches.query: npj biophysical surrogate digital twins neural interfaces

verified_claims: The 2026 review describes hybrid volume-conduction, neural-response and transduction models plus surrogate optimization.
It surveys SCS among several neuroprosthetic applications and identifies calibration and personalization limits.
limitations: This is a review and conceptual framework, not a released SCS digital-twin implementation or dataset.
The paper notes that subject-specific calibration remains early and assumptions are substantial.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Review framework for biophysical and surrogate digital twins used to optimize neural interfaces, including SCS.
decisions.note: Use for modeling requirements and limitations, not implementation evidence.

searches.query: FAU multiscale digital twins spinal cord Pareto

verified_claims: The FAU project page states an aim to create multiscale spinal-cord digital twins and explore Pareto-optimal parameter solutions.
limitations: The page describes an ongoing research direction and provides no validated software, dataset or clinical results.
No patient-specific pain or ECAP prediction claim is supported.
decisions.corrected_purpose: FAU research-program page on multiscale spinal-cord digital twins and Pareto-oriented eSCS design.
decisions.note: Treat as prospective prior art, not a reusable artifact.

searches.query: Nature Methods Method of the Year 2025 EM connectomics

verified_claims: Nature Methods selected electron-microscopy-based connectomics as Method of the Year 2025.
The editorial discusses whole-brain Drosophila/FlyWire and other connectomics achievements.
limitations: The award is for EM-based connectomics broadly, not for FlyWire alone.
An editorial distinction is not validation of a particular simulator or pain-transfer hypothesis.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Editorial context for EM-based connectomics and the methodological significance of FlyWire-scale reconstructions.
decisions.note: Resource title was broader than the verified editorial scope and is corrected in purpose.

searches.query: Shiu Drosophila computational brain model Nature 2024

verified_claims: The article implements a Brian2 LIF model of 127,400 central-brain neurons using FlyWire connectivity and transmitter identity.
Feeding and grooming predictions were tested with optogenetics, imaging and behaviour; one unbiased cell-type screen exceeded 90% accuracy.
limitations: The greater-than-90% result is task- and screen-specific, not 91% whole-brain prediction accuracy.
The authors note zero baseline firing, missing neuromodulation and inaccurate absolute firing-rate assumptions.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Primary whole-central-brain LIF model for experimentally testable feeding and grooming sensorimotor circuits.
decisions.note: The imported global 91% accuracy claim was narrowed to the actual evaluation.

searches.query: EVOKE closed-loop open-loop SCS 36 month trial

verified_claims: The EVOKE blinded randomized trial NCT02924129 compared ECAP-controlled closed-loop with fixed-output open-loop SCS.
At 36 months the publication reports 77.6% versus 49.3% achieving at least 50% overall back/leg pain reduction.
limitations: The imported JPHV 2026 pooled-analysis identity was not confirmed as a stable primary publication.
The RR 1.47 figure must not replace the directly reported time-specific trial results and confidence intervals.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Primary EVOKE randomized-trial evidence for ECAP-controlled closed-loop versus open-loop SCS.
decisions.note: Underlying trial verified; the imported secondary-publication attribution remains unverified.

searches.query: Control Signals Closed-Loop SCS scoping review

verified_claims: The scoping review screened 688 unique articles and retained 28 publications covering 19 unique studies.
It categorized three subjective-state, seven position/movement and nine ECAP-control studies and found no fully integrated subjective-plus-biophysical model.
limitations: The result is a literature-gap statement, not proof that such integration improves outcomes.
ECAP is treated as spinal activation and a proxy for delivery changes, not direct pain intensity.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Scoping review of control signals used in closed-loop SCS for chronic pain.
decisions.note: Exact DOI 10.1016/j.neurom.2025.11.011 and counts were confirmed.

searches.query: Eon embodied brain emulation Drosophila NeuroMechFly

verified_claims: Eon describes integration of a FlyWire-derived LIF brain model with a NeuroMechFly/MuJoCo body.
The page identifies the work as an integration of existing brain and body models and discusses roughly 140,000 neurons and 50 million synapses.
limitations: The source is a company-authored demonstration, not peer-reviewed independent validation of embodied whole-brain emulation.
The demonstrated behaviours and brain-body interface require code, protocol and ablation review before scientific use.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Company technical account of an experimental FlyWire-LIF and NeuroMechFly/MuJoCo integration.
decisions.note: Do not cite it as validated brain upload, nociception model or emergent-behaviour evidence.
